people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

translations.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Dan, including these cities and their villages.
